name: Roblox Studio MCP
description: Read and edit scripts, inspect your place, and run playtests in Roblox Studio.
why: Roblox's built-in server connects your coding harness directly to an open Studio session.

setup.label: Enable in Studio
setup.detail: Update Roblox Studio. Open Assistant > ... > Manage MCP Servers and turn on Enable Studio as MCP server.

setup.label: Quick Connect
setup.detail: In Studio's MCP settings, enable your harness under Quick connect. Roblox lists Codex CLI, Claude Code, and Antigravity. Restart Studio if your installed harness is missing.

setup.label: OpenCode or manual connection
setup.detail: Use Studio's stdio setup instructions at https://create.roblox.com/docs/studio/mcp. Windows launches cmd.exe with arguments /c and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Roblox\mcp.bat. macOS launches /Applications/RobloxStudio.app/Contents/MacOS/StudioMCP. Use your harness's MCP configuration format.

setup.label: Verify
setup.detail: Keep Studio open, restart your harness, and check for the green connected-client indicator in Studio's MCP settings.

cautions: Connected clients can modify your open places and execute Luau code. Save your work before running edits or playtests.
